summary: The Complete Butterfly Guard covers Marcelo Garcia’s seated posture, sweeps, submissions and responses to standing opponents.
description: A butterfly course combining upper-body controls and sweeps with distance management and pressure responses.
overview: Marcelo Garcia’s The Complete Butterfly Guard develops seated posture and sweeping before expanding into upper-body attacks and engagement. The four volumes include elbow control, shoulder-clamp sweeps, armlocks and the Marcelotine. Distance-closing and standing-opponent material address exchanges where the passer does not stay in front of the butterfly hooks.

fits: You want seated butterfly offense with ways to engage opponents who stand, retreat or pressure forward.

includes: Hand, foot and elbow positioning; butterfly sweeps, shoulder clamps and upper-body submissions.
Closing distance, shin-to-shin against standing opponents and responses to forward pressure.
limits: Butterfly and seated engagement are the focus; full X-guard entries and sweeping finishes are not the course’s central subject.
